subject.title: fix(sandbox): repair fs bridge stat for Codex exec-server native writes

question: Should OpenClaw accept the fs bridge read-only stat expansion for mount roots, existing directories, and missing stat parents in the sandbox exec-server path?
rationale: The code evidence supports the bug fix, but the touched files are a sandbox boundary owned by secops and the review cannot replace that owner acceptance.

options.title: Require sandbox owner approval
options.body: Have the sandbox/CODEOWNER reviewer explicitly accept the read-only stat classification before merge.

options.title: Accept current proof
options.body: Merge based on the supplied live proof and regression tests while owning the boundary change as intentional.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until a sandbox owner can review or request a narrower boundary shape.

recommendation.title: Require sandbox owner approval
recommendation.body: Have the sandbox/CODEOWNER reviewer explicitly accept the read-only stat classification before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest current-main ownership signal on fs bridge and fs-safe boundary changes in the touched files.
